howItWorks.step1: Paste owner/repo, github.com/owner/repo, or a full HTTPS GitHub URL.
howItWorks.step2: Generate a short link, then copy it or download its QR code.
howItWorks.step3: The link follows the repository when it is renamed or transferred.

help.intro: Create a permanent short link and QR code for a public GitHub repository.

privacy.note: No account is required. Your IP is used for rate limits and request logs. Cloudflare Turnstile verifies link submissions.

qr.customize: Customize foreground and background colors, error correction, size, margin, and corner roundness.
qr.export: Export as SVG, PNG, or JPG. Filenames use the short link.
